findings.claim: Airbnb 2026 Summer Release 擴充 Services（雜貨配送、租車、機場接送、行李寄放）並新增獨立精品飯店，朝一站式旅遊平台轉型
findings.source: eCommerceNews: Airbnb adds car hires, hotels, World Cup experiences
findings.excerpt: Airbnb has added car rentals, grocery delivery, airport pick-ups, luggage storage, boutique hotels and new app tools to its platform. The expansion also includes exclusive FIFA World Cup 2026 experiences.

findings.claim: Chesky 稱 Airbnb 自有 AI 平台是對抗去中介化的最強防禦，並批評對手聊天機器人
findings.excerpt: intelligence, arguing that its “intentional path” toward a native AI platform is “our strongest defense against disintermediation.” Chesky was addressing the fear AI platforms threaten Airbnb and other booking sites. And he criticized competitors who rushed to market with AI chatbots.
